```json
"topology": "Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS 2nd stage, nulling resistor)",
"rationale": "Two gain stages with long-L devices give about 75 dB, which leaves margin for gain and PSRR. The current budget is Iref 10 uA + tail 6 uA + second stage 15 uA = 31 uA, about 61 uW at 1.98 V. The input pair is long-L, large-area and weak-inversion to keep flicker noise low and Vgs small at VCM. Cc of about 10 pF sets the UGBW near 700 kHz. p2 (gm7/CL, about 9 MHz) and Rz give a phase margin above 75 deg. The second stage has a single output device, so swing is wide."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion: low Vgs, low noise)
    "L1":    (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),        # input pair L (area -> flicker noise)
    "Itail": (6e-6, 3e-6, 12e-6),    # first-stage tail current
    "gmidL": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load / M7 gm/Id (matched)
    "LL":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # PMOS mirror / M7 length (matched -> low systematic offset)
    "I7":    (15e-6, 8e-6, 25e-6),   # second-stage current
    "Cc":    (10e-12, 5e-12, 20e-12),# Miller cap
    "kRz":   (1.3, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = kRz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    gmid_t, Lt = 14.0, 2.0             # NMOS bias/tail/sink family (same gm/Id, L -> exact ratios)
    itail, i7, cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    # NMOS current references (all mirrored from ibias diode)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, itail, vds=0.2)          # tail, low Vds at VCM~0.81-0.9
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, i7, vds=0.9)             # 2nd-stage sink

    # input pair (body at vss, source ~0.15-0.2 V)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.15)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidL"], p["LL"], itail / 2, vds=1.0)
    # 2nd stage PMOS CS, matched current density with M3 so Vsg7 = Vsg3
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidL"], p["LL"], i7, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["kRz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp drives the side whose drain is the high-impedance node n1, which feeds the inverting 2nd stage
    # -> vinp is non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d2", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + c1 + cl * c1 / cc))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m7.cgg * 0 + m3.cdd))
    # zero with Rz: z = 1/(2pi*Cc*(1/gm7 - Rz)) -> LHP if Rz>1/gm7
    denom = (1.0 / m7.gm - rz)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir) / 2)
    if denom < 0:
        fz = 1 / (2 * PI * cc * (-denom))
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
    pm = min(pm, 89.0)
    slew = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i7)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    nth = math.sqrt(2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = nth * 8.0   # rough flicker allowance at 1 kHz
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 / m5.gds * a1 / max(a1, 1) * 1.0) + db(m3.gm / m3.gds) * 0.5
    psrr = gain_db - 3
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.2

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "power": power, "noise_1k": noise,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing}
```
